bridge: Latest Q2 drop declined1.9% YoY, rooms41% under renovation. Base -2%; bear -7%; bull +3%.
3% base payroll/contract inflation with 2% efficiency and 6% pressure cases. Apply to calibrated seasonally matched fixed-cost residual, not every cost line.

Normalized yield assumption, differentiated by operator/denominator. Historical complete-quarter weighted hold and July/August volatility retained in official_evidence.calibration; scenarios are judgments, not statistical confidence intervals.
Q2 points33.0/gross349.1 =9.45%;2025Q3 38.8/368.5=10.53%. Normalized base9.6%. Deduct from casino gross before adding casino F&B.
Q2 noncasino revenue-12.3%, room41% renovation. Seasonal comparison preserved; base-15%.

Reduced-form operating cost elasticity (casino-related variable operating costs / casino revenue). GKL28% approximates latest comps+promotion+tourism fund+excise share; Paradise32% and Lotte35% are explicit scenario modeling judgments with residual calibration. Kangwon28.2% is applied to casino gross operating revenue and comes from company IR levy rates, not to net revenue.
Volume growth scenario after hold normalization. Base assumes moderate tourism/recovery; bear weak inbound or renovation disruption; bull sustained visit/spend growth. No company guidance asserted.
Condo completion scheduled2027Q4; limited annual uplift while work continues.
Q2 2026 IR reports7.3bn bonus-expense reduction. Restore in forward fixed-cost baseline; actual Q2 unchanged.
Grand hotel completion scheduled2028Q1; capacity restoration scenario, not a company sales guide.
Assume company-indicated reinforcement depreciation2.7bn/quarter ends after2028Q1, matching scheduled2028-01 work completion. Completion-date risk retained.
